id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_040.pack|cs_: "Mia, I know you're in there. Come out!

"...No. I'm never coming out.
  I'm staying here forever!

"The world's at peace now.
  What are you sulking about?

"I'm not sulking.
  I just heard what the priest said.

"I don't remember before I woke, but
  I turned monster and rampaged,
  even against bro...

"Bro and his friends must think
  I'm a nuisance. Well,
  I'm used to being hated...
"...Oh? There's gold lying on the ground here!

"Gold!? Where, where!
  Where is it, bro!?

"Ha ha! There you go!
  That thick skin is what makes you, you.
  Moping doesn't suit you!

"You tricked me, you dumb bro!
  I was so worried you hated me...

"If you really care about everyone,
  hurry up and get that body fixed.
  ...Everyone's worried about you.

"...Besides, until you're better,
  we can't go off on
  that treasure-hunting trip, can we?

"That's right. This time, the two of us
  will search the whole world for treasure.
  So get well soon!

"W-well, if you insist so much, bro...
  I guess I could go with you.
